title: Titan Company Limited (NSE: TITAN) — Institutional Investment Dossier
holding_rationale: TITAN is not held in our Zerodha account (₹4,326,923.94 net worth; ₹1,373,602.19 cash). Fundamentals pass as COMPOUNDER_PASS. However, the November 13, 2026 ledger close (₹4,844.90) flags Stage 3 (Topping / Pullback) with a falling/flat 50-DMA (₹4,696.38), 6 distribution days, and -7.88% 63-day RS. At CMP, 25/50/25 EV (₹5,350, +10.43%) trails our 11.0% cost of equity. We assign WAIT_FOR_SUPPORT (0% immediate deployment). We target ₹4,550.00–₹4,696.38 support (2.85:1 asymmetry to ₹5,600.00 vs ₹4,380.00 stop) once 50-DMA stabilizes.

holding_alerts.instruction: Watch for stabilization and volume dry-up at the ₹4,696.38 50-DMA / ₹4,678.06 10W EMA shelf before staging GTT buy orders.
Lower bound of the ₹4,550.00–₹4,696.38 support buy zone (above 200-DMA ₹4,473.50); deploy only if Stage 2 / 50-DMA slope stabilizes.
Hard invalidation stop at ₹4,380.00 (below 200-DMA ₹4,473.50); cancel all pending buy orders or exit 100% if breached on a weekly close.
Re-assess valuation and trail stop upward to breakeven/10W EMA if TITAN reaches ₹5,600.00.

primer: Titan Company Limited is India's top jewellery and lifestyle compounder, valued at ₹4,30,611.81 crore (62.0x headline TTM P/E; 67.6x normalized ex-one-off P/E) at ₹4,844.90 on November 13, 2026. Titan earns 45.3% ROE (37.7% Screener) with zero dilution since FY15, and Q2 FY27 normalized profit rose 54% YoY. Yet the session ledger flags Stage 3 (Topping / Pullback) with a falling 50-DMA (₹4,696.38) and 6 distribution days. CMP expected return (+10.43%) also trails our 11.0% hurdle. We assign WAIT_FOR_SUPPORT (Tier-2), targeting ₹4,550.00–₹4,696.38 support (2.85:1 asymmetry to ₹5,600.00; ₹4,380.00 stop) while holding 100% cash.
